answer: You may tier cost-sharing for contracted providers to steer enrollees to providers you identify based on efficiency and quality data, but you must fully disclose the tiered amounts and requirements, make the services at each tier available to all enrollees, not limit enrollees to a particular tier, and charge all enrollees the same amount for the same service by the same provider. You may offer two or more physician groups with different cost-sharing, but you may not require an enrollee to get all needed care for the year from a particular provider group.

citations.quote: MA plans may choose to tier the cost-sharing for contracted providers as an incentive to encourage enrollees to seek care from providers the plan identifies based on efficiency and quality data.

The plan fully discloses tiered cost-sharing amounts and requirements to enrollees and plan providers; o The services at each tier of cost-sharing are available to all enrollees; o Enrollees may not be limited to obtaining services from providers/suppliers assigned to a particular tier; and o All enrollees are charged the same amount for the same service provided by the same provider.
it may not require that an enrollee receive all needed care during the contract year from a particular provider group.

gold_answer: The plan must fully disclose the tiered amounts and requirements to enrollees and providers, make every tier's services available to all enrollees, not limit enrollees to providers in a particular tier, and charge everyone the same amount for the same service from the same provider.
gold_quote: The tiered cost-sharing must satisfy the following standards: o The plan fully discloses tiered cost-sharing amounts and requirements to enrollees and plan providers; o The services at each tier of cost-sharing are available to all enrollees; o Enrollees may not be limited to obtaining services from providers/suppliers assigned to a particular tier; and o All enrollees are charged the same amount for the same service provided by the same provider.

judge.rationale: The answer lists all four required standards that appear in the gold answer, and every claim, including the efficiency/quality basis and the physician-group example, is found in P3 and P5.
